ops.text: cc-guides render is failing intermittently fleet-wide today (3 failures in ~1h: synckit x2, cc-present x1) with "could not resolve source ref https://github.com/yasyf/cc-skills.git@main: signal: killed" at ~25-110s — the resolver's git fetch of cc-skills is being killed on GitHub runners, likely OOM or an internal timeout under the concurrent render load of a many-repo ship day.
